title: The Ninth Bay Drop
venue: Bayline Golf Social • Fictional Baton Rouge, Louisiana
description: An easy guided mystery at a fictional Baton Rouge golf-entertainment lounge. A birthday league host is found beside Bay Nine after a sudden scoreboard failure, and the first contradiction is hidden in the bay mat and wristband scans.

answerKey.method: Struck Mason with a weighted swing trainer during the scoreboard blackout, then dragged it behind the club rack and staged the scene as a fall from the bay platform.
answerKey.motive: Mason discovered Talia had been quietly selling private party score overrides to win corporate league bets.
answerKey.keyEvidence: Bay mat drag mark, weighted trainer grip print, wristband scan at Bay Nine, and the hidden override receipt.
answerKey.explanation: Talia claimed she stayed at the host podium, but her wristband opened Bay Nine during the blackout. The weighted trainer carried her grip pattern, and the floor mat showed the body was moved after the impact.

publicClues.title: Case Opened
publicClues.text: Mason Bell is found beside Bay Nine after the birthday league lights flicker and the leaderboard drops to black. The hitting mat smells like rubber warmed by rain, and a line of loose turf fibers runs toward the club rack instead of the tee line.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: A range attendant points at Bay Nine and says the mat was straight when the group arrived. Talia Reed answers too quickly from the host podium: “People trip over those mats all night.”

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: The scoreboard reboots with one bay missing from the rotation. A bartender notices Talia staring at the blank space before anyone says which bay failed.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: A kid from the party lane asks why the heavy orange training club is behind the rack. No one remembers it being used during warmups.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: Rain taps against the netting. Fresh rubber dust clings to one side of Mason’s sleeve, matching the side that would have brushed the shifted mat.

publicClues.title: Live Scene Update
publicClues.text: The host podium printer spits out a delayed score override receipt. Talia reaches for it, then stops when everyone turns toward the sound.

phone.title: Wristband Door Ping
phone.text: At 8:47 PM, Talia Reed’s wristband opened the service latch beside Bay Nine. She later claimed she never left the host podium during the blackout.

phone.title: Missed Call From Mason
phone.text: Mason called Talia twice before the party began. The second call ended after seven seconds, just long enough for someone to say “the overrides stop tonight.”

messages.title: Score Override Text
messages.text: A message to Talia reads: “If Mason talks, the league bets are done.” The message was deleted, but the preview remained in notification storage.

messages.title: Host Podium Message
messages.text: A scheduled message from Talia says, “Bay Nine will reset during the blackout.” The message was written before the lights failed.

maps.title: Podium-to-Bay Route
maps.text: The staff tracker shows the host podium is only twenty steps from Bay Nine through the service lane. It can be crossed in under twenty seconds during a crowd distraction.

maps.title: Training Club Rack Movement
maps.text: A small locator tag on the weighted trainer moves from the warmup rack to Bay Nine during the blackout, then returns to the rack two minutes later.

bank.title: Private League Payment
bank.text: Talia received three small transfers from corporate league players marked “score help.” Mason’s phone had screenshots of the same payments.

bank.title: Refund Draft
bank.text: Mason had drafted refund notices for every party that paid for a score override. The draft named the host podium account as the source.

photos.title: Bay Mat Photo
photos.text: The first scene photo shows the hitting mat angled toward the club rack. Loose turf fibers gather on the wrong side, suggesting the mat was dragged after Mason fell.

photos.title: Training Club Grip
photos.text: A close photo of the orange weighted trainer shows a damp thumb mark on the lower grip. The mark faces the impact side, not the practice-swing side.

social.title: Birthday League Story
social.text: A guest video catches the scoreboard going black. In the reflection, Talia’s purple blazer is visible moving toward Bay Nine.

social.title: Deleted Winner Post
social.text: A saved draft on Talia’s social account congratulates the wrong team before the final round was played. It was tied to the same score override account.

contacts.title: Witness Statement: Juno Park, range attendant
contacts.text: Juno says the mat at Bay Nine was flat at the start of the party, and the orange weighted trainer was on the warmup rack before the blackout.

contacts.title: Suspect Statement: Talia Reed, event host
contacts.text: Talia says she stayed at the host podium and only noticed Bay Nine after everyone started shouting. She insists the blackout made everyone look suspicious.

contacts.title: Witness Statement: Brett Lyle, bartender
contacts.text: Brett heard the podium printer jam right after the lights flickered and saw Talia glance at the paper tray before anyone mentioned a receipt.

contacts.title: Suspect Statement: Keon Mott, league captain
contacts.text: Keon admits he paid for a score boost but says Mason threatened to expose the whole thing before the final round. He says Talia handled the setup.

notes.title: Rubber Dust on Sleeve
notes.text: Mason’s sleeve carries rubber dust on the side facing the club rack, not the tee line. That fits a body shifted across the mat after impact.

notes.title: Override Receipt Jam
notes.text: The host podium printer jammed on a score override receipt at the exact time the blackout began. The receipt links Bay Nine to Talia’s login.

files.title: League Admin Log
files.text: The admin log shows Talia’s host account made a final score correction two minutes before Mason was found.

files.title: Incident Report Draft
files.text: A draft incident report describes Mason as “tripping over a loose mat,” but it was created before the mat had been photographed by staff.

browser.title: Search: Weighted Trainer Injury
browser.text: The host podium browser searched whether a weighted swing trainer could cause a fatal head injury if swung from close range.

browser.title: Scoreboard Blackout Instructions
browser.text: The browser history includes instructions for forcing a single bay scoreboard reboot without shutting down the entire venue.

openingNarration: Detectives arrive at Bayline Golf Social after a birthday league collapses into panic. Mason Bell is dead, the scoreboard failed, and one person near the host podium knows the blackout created a perfect short window.
revealScript: The scene did not begin with a fall. It began with Talia Reed using the blackout to strike Mason with the weighted trainer, then shifting the mat and hiding the club as if Bay Nine caused the accident.
